implementation: Junos OS Evolved OpenSSL Cryptographic Module (ECDH K/B)
description: OpenSSL library implementation providing cryptographic services to Linux user space software components. The module was tested with 64 bit word size. The following cipher implementation is covered: ECDH with K and B curves.
